summary: Credits posted to orphaned cost center after asynchronous postback reroute
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that credits for a recent reserved-capacity warmup window were posted to an orphaned cost center (cost_center_id: cc-ORPHAN-992) instead of the customer's dedicated cost center. Impact: NimbleDocs is seeing a negative provisional balance and an unexpected charge on a finalized invoice; finance hold requested. Environment: prod (dedicated), us-east-1; reserved-hours swap executed during maintenance window 2026-03-11 02:00-03:30 UTC.

Observed behavior: Postback reroute during an in-flight reserved-capacity swap appears to have reclassified postbacks with old tenant tags and a null cost-center fallback. Affected postbacks correspond to hourly buffer/warmup credits between 2026-03-11T02:12:00Z and 2026-03-11T02:46:00Z.

Expected behavior: Credits should be attributed to NimbleDocs' dedicated cost center (cc-NIMBLE-004).

Customer request: Please reassign the missing credits to the correct cost center and provide a provisional credit memo while investigation completes.

Included artifacts: postback IDs, sample log lines, dashboard snapshots (links above).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger a reserved-capacity swap for a dedicated pool that includes active hourly-warmup jobs (simulated via staging job with tag mimic).
2) During the swap window, force a postback-reconciler leader election (kill reconciler pod) to induce asynchronous reroute and replay behavior.
3) Observe postback routing for warmup credit messages: look for tag normalization and cost_center lookup fallback logic in postback-reconciler logs.
4) Run billing attribution query to see where credits landed (SQL provided in investigation notes).
logs: 2026-03-11T02:13:04Z postback-reconciler INFO postback_id=pback-7a8f tag_normalizer=apply -> tenant_tag=nimbledocs-prod cost_center_lookup=cc-NIMBLE-004
2026-03-11T02:13:05Z postback-reconciler WARN postback_id=pback-7a8f route=async_reroute fallback=orphaned_cost_center cost_center_id=cc-ORPHAN-992
2026-03-11T02:15:21Z billing-service INFO reconcile_job=hourly_buffer credits_applied=1200 postback_batch=2026-03-11T02:00Z->02:30Z attributed_cost_center=cc-ORPHAN-992
Sample postback IDs: pback-7a8f, pback-7a99, pback-7b01, pback-7b22
comments: 2026-03-12 09:07 - Maya Chen (Support): Customer opened ticket. Attached invoice snippet showing negative provisional balance and screenshot of cost center list. Requested provisional credit while we investigate.

2026-03-12 10:45 - Rafael Ortiz (Billing Eng): Acked. I've scheduled reconciler logs capture for 02:00-03:30 UTC and queued a replay of affected postbacks into a safe dry-run reconciler to reproduce attribution path.
2026-03-12 14:12 - NimbleDocs Billing Contact (S. Alvarez): Confirming we saw a -$3,200 provisional on the March 11 invoice. Please escalate; finance needs a memo to avoid payment hold.

2026-03-13 08:32 - Rafael Ortiz (Billing Eng): Dry-run replay reproduced reroute to fallback cost center when leader election coincided with tag cache refresh (race between tag-service and postback-reconciler). Attaching initial SQL result set.

2026-03-13 12:05 - Priya Patel (SRE): Deployed a short-lived hotfix to add stronger null-checks and a guard for fallback attribution. Will monitor for 24 hours before rolling to prod-wide reconcilers.
2026-03-14 07:58 - Maya Chen (Support): Notified customer of provisional credit being queued (internal memo ID: MEMO-2026-03-NIMBLE). Awaiting final accounting delta after batch reprocess.
investigation_notes: Query run: SELECT postback_id, attributed_cost_center, original_tag, created_at FROM postbacks WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-11T02:10:00Z' AND '2026-03-11T02:50:00Z' AND (attributed_cost_center LIKE 'cc-ORPHAN%'); returned 4 postbacks totaling 1,200 warmup credits.
Hypothesis: race condition where tag-service responded slowly after swap; postback-reconciler fallback logic assigns a default orphaned cost center when cost_center lookup is null.
Evidence: reconciler WARN logs show fallback cost_center_id=cc-ORPHAN-992 at the exact timestamps of the reconciler leader election.

Impact assessment: affects only hourly-warmup credits and only requests during leader-election window; estimated dollar impact $3,200 and affects single NimbleDocs invoice line. No model inference charges affected.
Temporary mitigation executed: manual replay of affected postbacks through reconciler dry-run and a provisional credit created (internal memo MEMO-2026-03-NIMBLE).
Root cause candidate: postback-reconciler used an older cache key when tag-service returned 504; fallback mapping to orphan cost center is not safely guarded.
resolution: Mitigation in progress: provisional credit MEMO-2026-03-NIMBLE issued to NimbleDocs and queued immediate reprocessing of 4 affected postbacks to correct cost_center attribution. SRE deployed a patch to add an attribution guard to postback-reconciler (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/postback-reconciler/pull/91). Awaiting final accounting batch run (expected completion 2026-03-15) and finance sign-off. If reprocessing fails, a manual invoice adjustment will be issued.
followup_actions: 1) Complete reprocess job and reconcile ledger entries by 2026-03-15.
2) Add unit/integration tests to cover tag-service null responses (owner: postback team).
3) Schedule a postmortem and update Postback Routing Runbook with leader-election guidance (owner: SRE + Billing Eng).
4) Create alert for fallback-attribution-rate > 0.1% per hour (owner: Observability).
